_readme: Reserved Confluence labels (ADR-0021, which supersedes ADR-0011). The old knowledge-scope axis is RETIRED: index membership and content routing now ride the ADR-0020 routing-label axis alone (the chunk.labels column + app.allowed_labels GUC + chunk_labels_read policy), and routing labels are validated against product_catalog.json, not this file. Source/company isolation (chunk_source_read / app.allowed_sources) is unchanged. This file now holds only the RESERVED scope 'classified', which must be present so the backend and ingestion know it: it is never a recognized/offerable scope, is excluded from GET /health, is never selectable by a request, and a 'classified' Confluence label removes a page from the index (design rule 5). Startup validation (knowledge_scopes.py): every 'name' must be lowercase and unique, and 'classified' must be present, or the backend exits non-zero. To recognize a new integration platform, add it to product_catalog.json and label the matching Confluence pages with its routing labels — nothing in this file changes.
